TESTIMONIALS.name: Andy Collen
TESTIMONIALS.quote: Jumping into a new ring of technology can sometimes be frustrating. However, the professional, talented folks at Social DNA Labs made App development fun and exciting. With Social DNA Labs, the possibilities are endless.

TESTIMONIALS.name: Jay Shah
TESTIMONIALS.quote: Social DNA Labs provided my business the Data Systems with fully-fledged digital marketing services encompassing demand generation, digital advertising, search engine optimization, marketing automation, and lead generation. Their team works as an extension of our team, who are extremely efficient and provide real-time metrics that indicate the constant value our organization is receiving.

TESTIMONIALS.name: Surendar PM
TESTIMONIALS.role: Thanks for making our work easier
TESTIMONIALS.quote: We can now easily manage our multiple worship spaces in one place without any booking issues. Thanks to the team for creating a user-friendly website and an effective booking management portal.

TESTIMONIALS.name: Stuart John
TESTIMONIALS.quote: The search results of my website across all search engines have steeply improved. Not only did they build a perfect website for my offline store, but they also made it a point to increase my brand’s online presence. My sales have since doubled.

TESTIMONIALS.name: Sekhar G K
TESTIMONIALS.quote: Their unique way of approaching the challenges my organization once faced highly impressed me. Most of my website visitors are now turning into buyers of my products. The Mobile App created by this Digital Enterprise for my business has boosted my company’s reputation.

TESTIMONIALS.name: Bruce Holt
TESTIMONIALS.quote: I had always received end-to-end support when it came to making my presence known on the web. My website quickly picked up over a million other similar sites. I do not exactly know what they do to make you an internet sensation. But there is one thing for sure; they are leading the Digital Marketing Agency in the industry.

TESTIMONIALS.name: Mark Levine
TESTIMONIALS.quote: Social DNA Labs provided us with services relating to IoT & web app development. Within just a few months, they closely studied and understood our products, strengths, and weaknesses. They developed result-oriented products for us that left all of us pleased. I admire their hard work and support along the way.

TESTIMONIALS.name: Melissa James
TESTIMONIALS.quote: I feel extremely glad to share all about the services and assistance I received from Social DNA Labs so far. From product selection at the hardware level to implementing blockchain applications, and overall product design, they produced outputs that helped my company to stay ahead of the game. After screening many companies, Social DNA Labs bagged the deal. They have an edge where they bring a true Engineering solution mindset.

TESTIMONIALS.name: Will Twidwell
TESTIMONIALS.quote: The team from Social DNA Labs is like an extension of our development team. They closely work with our internal teams to deliver on-time results. We have recently undertaken a project involving AngularJS that is contributing significantly to enhancing our product and architecture. They have also provided us with additional resources to support the prototype development of certain concepts.

PILLARS.title: AI transformation
PILLARS.desc: Identify meaningful opportunities, build practical AI capabilities and accelerate adoption. From strategy and generative AI to intelligent agents and AI-enabled engineering, we help turn experimentation into measurable business value. The result is AI that fits how your teams actually work, not a bolt-on feature nobody uses.

PILLARS.title: Digital engineering
PILLARS.desc: Create, modernize and scale digital products, applications and platforms. We combine strong engineering practices with modern architectures to help you ship faster, integrate more easily and build systems that hold up as the business grows. Every solution is built to be maintainable, secure and ready for what comes next.

PILLARS.title: Business transformation
PILLARS.desc: Modernize systems and processes to create stronger, more efficient ways of working. We look across people, technology and workflows to remove friction, connect disconnected systems and give teams the tools they need to move faster. The outcome is a business that runs on processes built for today, not decisions made years ago.

PILLARS.title: Digital experience
PILLARS.desc: Create digital experiences that work better for customers, employees and the business. From research and design to the systems that keep experiences consistent at scale, we focus on interactions that are intuitive, accessible and aligned with what people actually need. Better experience drives better outcomes on both sides of the relationship.

PILLARS.title: Growth transformation
PILLARS.desc: Bring AI search, SEO, digital marketing and digital channels together to create qualified demand and improve conversion. We connect strategy, content and measurement so every channel works toward the same outcome instead of pulling in different directions. The focus stays on attention that converts into real business results.

AI_CAPABILITIES.title: AI strategy & consulting
AI_CAPABILITIES.desc: Identify where AI can create meaningful business value and what it will take to get there. Assess AI readiness, prioritize high-value use cases and define a practical roadmap aligned with business priorities, technology capabilities and investment goals.

AI_CAPABILITIES.title: Generative AI
AI_CAPABILITIES.desc: Build practical applications around generative AI, from intelligent assistants and knowledge systems to content, search and customer experiences. Connect language models with business information and workflows to create AI experiences that are relevant, useful and grounded in context.

AI_CAPABILITIES.title: AI applications
AI_CAPABILITIES.desc: Turn intelligence into useful products and applications that solve specific business problems. Build capabilities such as intelligent search, recommendations, prediction and personalization around the people, processes and experiences they are designed to improve.

AI_CAPABILITIES.title: AI agents & automation
AI_CAPABILITIES.desc: Move beyond assistance with AI agents and intelligent workflows that can reason across information, coordinate tasks and take action within defined boundaries. Identify processes where intelligent automation can reduce manual effort, accelerate execution and improve how work moves across people and systems.

AI_CAPABILITIES.title: AI-enabled engineering
AI_CAPABILITIES.desc: Use AI throughout the engineering lifecycle to accelerate development, modernize applications, improve quality and increase developer productivity. Combine AI-assisted development, automated testing, code modernization and disciplined engineering practices to deliver faster without compromising production quality.

AI_CAPABILITIES.title: AI integration & modernization
AI_CAPABILITIES.desc: Bring AI into the technology landscape already running the business. Connect AI capabilities with applications, data, APIs, CRM, ERP, e-commerce and cloud platforms, while modernizing existing technology where AI can improve how systems and capabilities work.

DX_CAPABILITIES.title: Experience strategy
DX_CAPABILITIES.desc: Define the experience direction across products, services and digital touchpoints. Combine research, customer and employee needs, business goals and technology realities to prioritize where experience improvements can create the greatest value.

DX_CAPABILITIES.title: UX strategy
DX_CAPABILITIES.desc: Understand users, their needs and the journeys they take across digital touchpoints. Define information architecture, user flows, experience priorities and design direction that align customer needs with business goals.

DX_CAPABILITIES.title: UI design
DX_CAPABILITIES.desc: Create clear, consistent and accessible interfaces across web, mobile and digital platforms. Establish visual hierarchy, interaction patterns and responsive designs that make products easier to understand and use.

DX_CAPABILITIES.title: Product design
DX_CAPABILITIES.desc: Bring user needs, business priorities and technology together throughout the product lifecycle. From discovery and ideation to prototyping and validation, design products that solve the right problems and are ready to evolve.

ZH_CAPABILITIES.title: Zoho consulting
ZH_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Find the right applications and approach.
ZH_CAPABILITIES.desc: Identify the right Zoho applications, define the implementation approach and align the platform with business processes and priorities.

ZH_CAPABILITIES.title: Zoho implementation
ZH_CAPABILITIES.desc: Configure and deploy Zoho applications with the workflows, roles, data structures and business rules required for day-to-day operations.

ZH_CAPABILITIES.title: Zoho customization
ZH_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Extend the platform to fit the business.
ZH_CAPABILITIES.desc: Extend standard Zoho capabilities to accommodate unique processes, specialized workflows and business requirements.

ZH_CAPABILITIES.title: Zoho integration
ZH_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Connect Zoho to the rest of the business.
ZH_CAPABILITIES.desc: Connect Zoho with ERP, e-commerce, finance, websites, third-party applications and other business systems.

ZH_CAPABILITIES.title: Data migration
ZH_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Move existing data in without the mess.
ZH_CAPABILITIES.desc: Move existing customer, product, transaction and operational data into Zoho with structured migration and validation.

ZH_CAPABILITIES.title: Workflow automation
ZH_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Automate the repetitive parts of the work.
ZH_CAPABILITIES.desc: Automate repetitive processes, approvals, notifications and data flows across Zoho applications.

ZH_CAPABILITIES.title: Zoho application development
ZH_CAPABILITIES.desc: Build custom functions, extensions and applications when standard capabilities are not enough.

ZH_CAPABILITIES.title: Support & optimization
ZH_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Keep an existing Zoho environment improving.
ZH_CAPABILITIES.desc: Improve an existing Zoho environment through ongoing enhancements, troubleshooting, optimization and support.

ZH_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Reduce disconnected work
ZH_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Connect applications and workflows so teams spend less time moving information between systems.

ZH_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Adapt the platform
ZH_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Configure and extend Zoho around business requirements instead of relying entirely on out-of-the-box processes.

ZH_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Grow without unnecessary complexity
ZH_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Start with the applications the business needs and expand the platform as requirements evolve.

SF_CAPABILITIES.title: Salesforce consulting
SF_CAPABILITIES.desc: Translate business and customer-management requirements into a practical Salesforce architecture, configuration and implementation approach.

SF_CAPABILITIES.title: Salesforce implementation
SF_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Configure Salesforce for how sales works.
SF_CAPABILITIES.desc: Configure Salesforce around sales processes, customer data, workflows, roles and reporting requirements.

SF_CAPABILITIES.title: Salesforce customization
SF_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Extend the platform for what standard can’t cover.
SF_CAPABILITIES.desc: Extend standard Salesforce capabilities to support business processes and requirements that need a more tailored solution.

SF_CAPABILITIES.title: Salesforce integration
SF_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Connect Salesforce to the rest of the business.
SF_CAPABILITIES.desc: Connect Salesforce with ERP, finance, e-commerce, marketing, service and other applications to create a more complete business ecosystem.

SF_CAPABILITIES.title: Data migration
SF_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Move customer data in with confidence.
SF_CAPABILITIES.desc: Plan and execute migration of customer, account, contact, opportunity and other business data into Salesforce.

SF_CAPABILITIES.title: Workflow & automation
SF_CAPABILITIES.tagline: Automate the repetitive parts of selling.
SF_CAPABILITIES.desc: Automate repetitive sales and customer processes through workflows, approvals, notifications and system integrations.

SF_CAPABILITIES.title: Salesforce optimization
SF_CAPABILITIES.desc: Improve existing Salesforce environments through configuration changes, process improvements, integration enhancements and ongoing optimization.

SF_VALUE_ITEMS.title: One view of the customer
SF_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Bring customer information together so teams can work from a more complete picture.

SF_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Cleaner sales processes
SF_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Standardize workflows, approvals and processes without adding unnecessary complexity.

SF_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Less manual work
SF_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Automate repetitive activities and reduce duplicate data entry across customer-facing teams.

SF_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Better visibility
SF_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Give managers and teams clearer insight into pipelines, activities, customers and performance.

SF_VALUE_ITEMS.title: A platform that can evolve
SF_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Build a Salesforce environment that can adapt as processes, teams and business requirements change.
